segments.english: At OCP, our mission is to re-imagine data center, telco, and edge infrastructures to achieve greater choice, customization and cost savings, and OCP solution providers play a vital role in making that mission a reality by delivering and supporting integrated solutions, providing local engineering architecture resources for customers, establishing and maintaining relationships with manufacturers of OCP products, taking part in business planning sessions with the Foundation to better align with your company's goals, and of course, actively participating in the OCP Community.
segments.localized: 在 OCP，我们的使命是重新构想数据中心、电信和边缘基础设施，从而提供更多选择和定制能力并节省成本。OCP 解决方案提供商通过交付和支持集成解决方案、为客户提供本地工程与架构资源、与 OCP 产品制造商建立并维护合作关系、参加与基金会的业务规划会议以更好地契合贵公司的目标，当然还包括积极参与 OCP 社区，在实现这一使命方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
segments.spoken_text: 在 OCP，我们的使命是重新构想数据中心、电信和边缘基础设施，从而提供更多选择和定制能力并节省成本。OCP 解决方案提供商通过交付和支持集成解决方案、为客户提供本地工程与架构资源、与 OCP 产品制造商建立并维护合作关系、参加与基金会的业务规划会议以更好地契合贵公司的目标，当然还包括积极参与 OCP 社区，在实现这一使命方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

segments.english: Interested in becoming a solution provider?
segments.localized: 想成为解决方案提供商吗？
segments.spoken_text: 想成为解决方案提供商吗？

segments.english: The first thing you'll need to do is become an OCP Corporate Member by signing the appropriate provider agreement and paying the appropriate fee.
segments.localized: 首先，您需要签署相应的提供商协议并支付相应费用，成为 OCP 企业会员。
segments.spoken_text: 首先，您需要签署相应的提供商协议并支付相应费用，成为 OCP 企业会员。

segments.english: The next step is to build your product based on an approved OCP specification or design package if you're a colo solution provider, to complete the OCP Ready colo site assessment.
segments.localized: 接下来，请根据获批的 OCP 规范或设计包构建产品。托管服务提供商还须完成 OCP Ready 站点评估。
segments.spoken_text: 接下来，请根据获批的 OCP 规范或设计包构建产品。托管服务提供商还须完成 OCP Ready 站点评估。

segments.english: Once you do, you can enroll your product in the OCP product recognition program for OCP Accepted approval, or submit your colo facility site assessment to our incubation committee for OCP Ready recognition.
segments.localized: 完成后，您可以将产品加入 OCP 产品认证计划以申请 OCP Accepted 批准，或向孵化委员会提交托管设施站点评估以申请 OCP Ready 认证。
segments.spoken_text: 完成后，您可以将产品加入 OCP 产品认证计划以申请 OCP Accepted 批准，或向孵化委员会提交托管设施站点评估以申请 OCP Ready 认证。

segments.english: When your product, solution or facility has been approved, you can get started marketing your OCP Accepted products, integrated solutions, or OCP Ready facility on our marketplace and throughout the world.
segments.localized: 产品、解决方案或设施获批后，您就可以在 OCP Marketplace 及全球范围内推广 OCP Accepted 产品、集成解决方案或 OCP Ready 设施。
segments.spoken_text: 产品、解决方案或设施获批后，您就可以在 OCP Marketplace 及全球范围内推广 OCP Accepted 产品、集成解决方案或 OCP Ready 设施。

segments.english: By participating in the OCP Community as a solution provider, you have the chance to bring greater efficiencies to your customers’ infrastructure, reach potential adopters, and most importantly, contribute to reimagining our world's IT infrastructure.
segments.localized: 作为解决方案提供商参与 OCP 社区，您有机会提高客户基础设施的效率、接触潜在采用者，更重要的是，为重新构想全球 IT 基础设施贡献力量。
segments.spoken_text: 作为解决方案提供商参与 OCP 社区，您有机会提高客户基础设施的效率、接触潜在采用者，更重要的是，为重新构想全球 IT 基础设施贡献力量。
